s1.syndrome_frame: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness with urinary retention and cranial nerve involvement
salient_findings: Subacute, progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness
Nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots
key_facts: MRI brain and orbits showed no abnormality
MRI spine showed nodular thickening and enhancement of lumbosacral nerve roots
Diffuse heterogeneous T1- and T2-weighted signal abnormalities within bone marrow
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated white blood cell count
Cerebrospinal fluid analysis showed elevated red blood cell count

differentials: Leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation
per_call: Leukoencephalopathy with brainstem and spinal cord involvement and lactate elevation

shortlist.label: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Presence of atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid and violaceous cutaneous lesions

shortlist.label: Acute myeloid leukemia
shortlist.why_kept: Severe flaccid quadriparesis, reduced muscle stretch reflexes, and diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities within bone marrow

shortlist.label: Leukemia cutis
shortlist.why_kept: Violaceous cutaneous lesions and presence of atypical cells/blasts in cerebrospinal fluid

shortlist.label: Neurolymphomatosis
shortlist.why_kept: Progressive, symmetric lower extremity weakness, urinary retention, and cranial nerve involvement

shortlist.label: Intravascular lymphoma
shortlist.why_kept: Subacute progression of symptoms, severe flaccid quadriparesis, and reduced muscle stretch reflexes

raw.rationale: The presence of violaceous cutaneous lesions (leukemia cutis), severe flaccid quadriparesis, reduced muscle stretch reflexes, and cerebrospinal fluid analysis showing 98% atypical cells/blasts are highly suggestive of leukemia, and the specific findings of nodular thickening and enhancement of the lumbosacral nerve roots and diffuse heterogeneous signal abnormalities within the bone marrow on MRI spine are more consistent with acute myeloid leukemia.

rejected.label: Acute lymphoblastic leukemia
rejected.why: Less likely due to the presence of leukemia cutis and specific MRI findings

rejected.label: Leukemia cutis
rejected.why: Leukemia cutis is a symptom, not a diagnosis, and the patient's presentation suggests an underlying leukemia

rejected.label: Neurolymphomatosis
rejected.why: The cerebrospinal fluid analysis and MRI findings are not typical for neurolymphomatosis

rejected.label: Intravascular lymphoma
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and imaging findings do not support a diagnosis of intravascular lymphoma

gold: Blastic plasmacytoid dendritic cell neoplasm (BPDCN) with polyradiculopathy
